title: LoadLibraryExW, simulated
hints: Keep a small `Loader` struct with the world, the flags, the folder of the top DLL, and a map of what has been loaded in this call. One recursive `load(name)` does the rest.
The "DLL load dir" is only known when the top DLL was given as a full path: take the part of the path before the last backslash.
requirements: Full paths load only that exact file.
Dependencies are loaded before the modules that need them, each once.
Search flags, or SetDefaultDllDirectories, replace the standard search order and leave out the current directory and PATH.
LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_DLL_LOAD_DIR lets a plugin find dependencies in its own folder.
